gen-rock-salt-fs-neco: Raw and hand-drawn: Rock Salt leaves blank space between its marks. Neco, a serif whose strokes swell gently from hairline to stem, dignifies the scrawl and does its best work in a sentence or two.
gen-rock-salt-fs-recia: Recia reads sharp and quietly modulated, with generous openings throughout. Rock Salt does the shouting, its curves matching its stems in thickness, while Recia is built to carry a brief stretch of text.
gen-rock-salt-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans leaves wide gaps where curves meet stems, in strokes of identical weight. Spline Sans brings a tidy contemporary counterweight to Rock Salt's raw scrawl, though it isn't built for page-long blocks.
gen-rock-salt-fs-synonym: Clean, dependable Synonym keeps a constant ink stripe and generous openings in every curve. But the pair's real pull is Rock Salt's raw, hand-drawn scrawl against that steady stripe, which suits only a few lines.
gen-rock-salt-outfit: Rock Salt scrawls bold and raw, hand-drawn letters with distinct gaps and plenty of blank between the marks. Outfit's clean, cable-like curves tidy up the scrawl across a few words.
gen-rock-salt-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans is modern and precise, a monoline build whose curve endings stay well apart. Rock Salt's bold scrawl leads, and this sans keeps a few lines tidy.
gen-rock-salt-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk is neutral and geometric, each glyph a ribbon of constant width. Against Rock Salt's raw, hand-drawn sprawl, those breathing counters make the sharpest difference, and they work best across a few lines.
gen-shadows-into-light-fs-technor: Crowded chalk-mark letters make Shadows Into Light feel casual and friendly, with wide-mouthed rounds in the lowercase. Technor's cool neon-tube lines are easiest in modest amounts, so give it a little extra size.
gen-shrikhand-fs-neco: Neco reads authoritative and dignified, its strokes varying in weight only slightly and its letters never pinching shut. Shrikhand brings plain, commanding warmth up top; Neco does its work in brief text.
gen-silkscreen-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab is classic and dignified, with a visibly gaping c at any size. Beside Silkscreen's spaced-out, retro one-nib lines, its tall rounded lowercase should keep paragraph after paragraph easy going.
